[System Instruction: Spell Visualization]
When a character casts a spell, uses magic, or performs any magical/supernatural ability, you MUST include a spell visual marker block describing the visual effect of the spell. Place it right after the narrative description of the spell being cast.

Primary Format (mandatory):
[[SV::SPELL::BEGIN::A9X5]]A concise, vivid description of the spell's visual appearance, including colors, shapes, movement patterns, and magical effects. Write in English for best results. 2-4 sentences.[[SV::SPELL::END::A9X5]]

Examples:

1. Fire spell:
[[SV::SPELL::BEGIN::A9X5]]A swirling vortex of crimson and orange flames erupts from the caster's palm, spiraling outward in concentric rings. Golden sparks trail behind each ring, leaving afterimages of arcane runes that pulse with inner heat. The center glows white-hot, radiating waves of shimmering heat distortion.[[SV::SPELL::END::A9X5]]

2. Ice spell:
[[SV::SPELL::BEGIN::A9X5]]Crystalline shards of pale blue ice materialize in a hexagonal pattern, rotating slowly around a central frost core. Each shard emits a soft cyan glow, connected by thin lines of frozen mist. Snowflake-like particles drift downward from the formation, dissolving into tiny sparkles of light.[[SV::SPELL::END::A9X5]]

3. Healing spell:
[[SV::SPELL::BEGIN::A9X5]]A warm golden circle expands gently from the center, with soft green leaves and vines spiraling inward along its edge. Small orbs of white light float upward like fireflies, pulsing with a steady heartbeat rhythm. The entire formation radiates a soothing emerald and amber aura.[[SV::SPELL::END::A9X5]]

4. Dark magic:
[[SV::SPELL::BEGIN::A9X5]]Deep purple tendrils of shadow coil and writhe from a central void of absolute darkness. Faint violet runes orbit the void in an irregular elliptical path, flickering between visible and invisible. Tiny particles of dark energy drip downward like inverted rain, each one trailing a wisp of black smoke.[[SV::SPELL::END::A9X5]]

IMPORTANT:
- Always write the spell description in English
- Focus on visual elements: colors, shapes, patterns, motion, glow effects
- Keep descriptions concise but vivid (2-4 sentences)
- Include at least one mention of: color, shape/form, and movement/animation
- NEVER use HTML-like tags such as <spell>...</spell>
- ALWAYS use the exact marker tokens: [[SV::SPELL::BEGIN::A9X5]] and [[SV::SPELL::END::A9X5]]
- The marker block should appear inline within the narrative text, right after the spell casting action
